notes.zh-Hans:
设置期间即开始接收镜像视频，不再等到启动任务才接收，以减少视频积压。校准和任务结束后保持实时视频传输，避免下次任务重新传输历史缓冲。视频诊断现包含任务启动阶段。校准检查点击未到达或测量误差过大时，不再报告成功；之前保存的失败校准不能用于操作。

需要配套 ESP32 固件更新，避免心跳和调试消息不必要地限制视频传输速度。已配对的视觉模型凭据会保留。请关闭辅助触控的“吸附到项目”，检查校准是否准确通过，然后确认任务能获取当前主屏幕并开始操作。iOS 27.2 beta 的端到端运行尚未验证。
notes.en-US:
Start receiving mirrored video during setup instead of waiting until a task starts, reducing the accumulated video backlog. Video remains running after calibration and completed tasks so the next task does not replay the buffered history again. Video diagnostics now include startup. Calibration no longer accepts a missing check click or a large measured error; previously saved failed calibrations cannot drive gestures.

Requires the companion ESP32 firmware update, which prevents heartbeat and debug messages from unnecessarily throttling video. The paired vision credential is preserved. Check that calibration passes accurately with Snap to Item disabled, then that tasks receive a current Home screen and begin acting. End-to-end operation on iOS 27.2 beta is not yet verified.
